svg.aria-label: What AIMA charges, and the ratio nobody warns about
svg.text: What AIMA charges, and the ratio nobody warns about
Fees payable to AIMA, in force from 1 March 2026. Each charge stands on its own; they are not paid at once.
One applicant, filing to first renewal: about 13,470 € in fees alone.
Less 25% when the application is filed online.
Legal fees and fund commissions are excluded: those are market prices, not published ones.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 6 September 2026
